The technical choices are over my head, honestly — I'll trust your judgment on the tools and how it's put together. What matters to me is that the plan still covers everything we agreed the app should do, and from your summary it sounds like it does: the auto-filled details and snapshots, my read-later list, the searching with all the pieces we worked out, saved searches, working on lots of bookmarks at once, sorting, and the display settings.

One thing I'm glad to see mentioned is keeping things safe — you noted protecting against dodgy fetched pages and archived content, which reassures me since the app is going out and grabbing pages on my behalf.

Go ahead and break it into the build tasks.
